responsibility: Defines the ISO sequential-stream file channel interface for non-rewindable or independent streams. It declares opening a named stream with read/write and text/raw flags, testing whether a ChanId is a stream file, and closing such a channel, providing the public device API for ordinary sequential file streams integrated with IOChan.
same_name_distinction: This .def file publishes the sequential stream-file channel API—open, type test, and close—without device details, unlike StreamFile.mod which builds and manages the underlying file-backed channel device.
